name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
description: One of the twelve Jyotirlingas, located on the western bank of the holy river Ganga.

name: Tirumala Venkateswara Temple
darshan_timings: Varies (Generally 2:30 AM to 1:30 AM next day)
description: One of the richest and most visited religious centers in the world.

name: Somnath Temple
description: The first among the twelve Aadi Jyotirlingas of India.

name: Shree Siddhivinayak Temple
description: A very popular temple dedicated to Lord Ganesha, often visited by celebrities and dignitaries.

name: ISKCON Temple
description: A major Vaishnava temple and center for spiritual learning.

name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
description: Historic Hindu temple known for its massive gopurams and exquisite architecture.

name: Jagannath Temple
description: Famous for its annual Rath Yatra, or chariot festival.

name: Kedarnath Temple
darshan_timings: 4:00 AM - 3:00 PM, 5:00 PM - 9:00 PM (May to Nov)
description: One of the Chardhams and a prominent Jyotirlinga situated in the Himalayas.

name: Badrinath Temple
darshan_timings: 4:30 AM - 1:00 PM, 4:00 PM - 9:00 PM (May to Nov)
description: One of the most important pilgrimage sites in India, part of the Char Dham yatra.

name: Dwarkadhish Temple
description: Also known as the Jagat Mandir, believed to have been built by Krishna's grandson.

name: Golden Temple (Sri Harmandir Sahib)
description: The holiest Gurdwara of Sikhism, revered by Hindus as well, symbolizing equality and brotherhood.

name: Swaminarayan Akshardham
description: A magnificent temple complex showcasing millennia of traditional Hindu and Indian culture.

name: Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga
description: Famous for the Bhasma Aarti, it is the only Jyotirlinga facing south (Dakshinamukhi).

name: Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple
description: The largest functioning Hindu temple in the world, dedicated to Lord Vishnu.

name: Vaishno Devi Temple
description: A deeply revered cave temple situated at an altitude of 5200 ft.
